sources.title: HABS CA-1981 Gamble House
sources.inspection: Read architectural description: wood frame/heavy timber, 36-inch cedar shakes dark olive green, brick/gunite foundations and three capped chimneys, overlapping Malthoid roofs and deep exposed rafters, red mission-tile terraces. Inspected drawing 3 first-floor plan. Additional online upper-floor/roof drawings returned server errors and are not claimed as inspected.
